title: NewSessionDialog Context Systems Show Nothing
user_notes: Context systems on the new session popup doesn't show anything. The Advanced Configuration section is completely empty.
fix_description: Root cause: NewSessionDialog calls window.deskflowAPI.system.list/status/verify/etc but the preload had NO 'system' namespace — only flat methods like getContextSystems. Every call hit 'if (!window.deskflowAPI?.system?.list) return' and silently bailed. Fix: added 'system' namespace to preload.ts with adapters that map existing IPCs (get-context-systems, list-init-files) and created 3 new IPC handlers (context-system-status, context-system-verify, get-agents-context) in main.ts.

title: Goal hub is unreachable: 5 root causes block Goal-as-the-hub
user_notes: The Goal is supposed to be the modular hub of the Life page — link a goal to todolist, habits, schedule, learning, sleep, everything. The backend is ~90% built and completely unreachable in practice. DO THESE IN ORDER; each is a prerequisite for the next.
fix_description: Stage 1a: added ensureGoalId() in goal-handlers.ts; BOTH save-goal and save-goals-batch now mint an id when the caller omits one (AiPage apply-plan sends {title,category,priority} with no id — that was the leak). Both handlers now return the id. Stage 1b: BACKFILLED 21 NULL ids in deskflow-data.db (backup at agent/backups/20260930-234450-*). 0 NULL ids remain, 27 rows / 27 distinct ids, integrity ok. Stage 1c: added an Accept/Dismiss review queue on GoldPage for the 11 status='suggested' goals that were filtered out with no way to reach them; widened the status type locally because the DB carries legacy AI statuses the canonical GoalStatus union does not declare. Verified statically only — NOT clicked in the running app.

checks.text: Backfill NULL goal ids in the DB (21 of 27 goals have id=NULL, so loadGoals drops them via `if (!g.id) continue`). Requires DB backup + explicit user OK first. Verify with SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goals WHERE id IS NULL

Fix response-shape mismatch: goal-handlers getGoalConnections returns {success,goal,parentLtgs,childGoals,todos,schedules,deadlines} but ConnectionExplorer reads res.connections.* (scheduleBlocks||schedules). Pick one shape and align both sides.

Make goal_id actually settable: todos/deadlines/schedule_entries/reminders all have the column but goal_id set = 0 everywhere. Add goal linking to each editor (ScheduleCard has a goal select, TodoList uses LinkPicker, deadlines/reminders have none).
Mount ConnectionExplorer on GoldPage and SchedulePage, not only HabitsPage:910 where it is reachable only by clicking a HierarchyTree node.

Expand the hub beyond its current 7 sections (Todos, Subtasks, Schedule, Deadlines, Parent, Linked Goal, Linked Habit) to the full CrossFeatureLink union: learn, finance, external, ide, focus, sleep, brain, notes, composition. Handler currently hardcodes notes:[] and brainEntities:[]. Verify each backing table has real data before wiring.

fix_description: Stage 1a: save-goal + save-goals-batch now mint an id (closes the leak for NEW rows). Stage 1b: backfilled all 21 existing NULL ids; 27/27 goals now survive loadGoals' `if (!g.id) continue`. Stage 1c: the 11 status='suggested' goals are now a visible review queue with Accept (status -> active) and Dismiss (delete, with state restore on failure) instead of being filtered out forever. All 27 goals now render on Gold.
